comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of the peptide shows 47.1% similarity to Eumenine mastoparan-AF. Mol Wt: 1837.154; GRAVY: 0.08. Activity:Active against Gram- V. parahaemolyticus (MIC 31.2 ug/mL), V. fluvialis (MIC 62.5 ug/mL), E. coli (MIC 3.9 ug/mL), Gram+ A. hydrophila (MIC 3.9 ug/mL), S. aureus (MIC 62.5 ug/mL), and S. pyogenes (MIC 62.5 ug/mL). Updated 6/2018; 7/2021.
